candidates.label: Smyrna (Roman-era city, İzmir)
candidates.support: This is the Roman-period city addressed in Revelation, at the location of modern İzmir's ancient agora, distinct from the earlier 'Old Smyrna' settlement at nearby Bayraklı; Pleiades and Wikidata's coordinates for the Roman-era site agree closely.

summary.text: Smyrna was a major Greek city on the Aegean coast of Asia Minor, at the site of modern İzmir. It is one of the seven churches addressed in Revelation 2-3, where the risen Christ commends the congregation's endurance under persecution and poverty without any rebuke.

scripture.textWEB: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”
